intro.title: Soft Romance
intro.body: Blush and cream tones, delicate textures and an airy silhouette. Use this mood as a starting point for a bouquet made around your occasion.
intro.reassurance: We’ll confirm flowers, fullness, extras and your preferred date with you.

labels.fullnessHelper: Illustrative options; the final bouquet and quote are confirmed on enquiry.

answers: The images show an inspiration. Flowers, colours and wrapping can vary; we’ll discuss the available options with you.
Share your preferred date, time and delivery location in your enquiry. Availability, timing and delivery details are confirmed in conversation.
For care advice, tell us which bouquet or arrangement you are enquiring about. We can discuss guidance for its flowers and presentation.
content.description: Tell us the occasion, the mood and your budget. We can discuss a bouquet direction that feels personal to you.
